name: io.github.nsideris/diffofday
title: Diff of the Day
description: Daily AI briefing for engineers: ranked stories, agent-ready build specs, small-team playbooks.

tools.name: get_idea_spec
tools.description: The full build spec (problem, goals, non-goals, requirements with acceptance criteria, agent instructions) for one Diff of the Day side-project idea, or for the small-team version of a big-company practice (kind "playbook"). Defaults to today, kind "idea", number 1.

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; omit for today

n.description: Number on that day, starting at 1

kind.description: "idea" for Ideas to try, "playbook" for From the big ones

tools.name: small_team_playbook
tools.description: What big tech companies publish about how they work, each with a small-team version and an agent-ready spec. Optionally filter by keyword (company, topic, practice).

days.description: How many recent editions to look through

tools.name: new_episodes
tools.description: New episodes from Lenny's Podcast, Dear Architects, The Pragmatic Engineer, The InfoQ Podcast, Rethink Engineering, GOTO – The Brightest Minds in Tech, newest first, with episode and audio links.

days.description: How many days back to look

tools.name: latest_edition
tools.description: Today's Diff of the Day: top AI stories for engineers, must-reads and trends, with links.

tools.name: get_edition
tools.description: The Diff of the Day edition for one date.

tools.name: ideas_to_try
tools.description: Side-project ideas built from a Diff of the Day edition: why each matters, concrete steps, effort and sources. Defaults to today.

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; omit for today

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search across every Diff of the Day story and link.

tools.name: list_trends
tools.description: The trend lines from recent editions.
